nodes.asset_description: Three skincare containers—a white squeeze tube, an amber dropper bottle with a gold collar, and a clear jar with a white lid—stand on a matte orange surface against a bright yellow backdrop. The minimalist studio shot uses strong side lighting to cast crisp shadows, creating a clean, graphic composition.

A minimal still life features a white ceramic pour-over dripper with coffee and a pipette, paired with a dark glass dropper bottle and a white lid. Set on a split yellow and peach background, the direct light casts sharp shadows that highlight the clean shapes and bold color contrast.

A clean, collage-style product ad shows coffee gear—a metal pour-over dripper, a bag of beans, and a cup of coffee—plus a pump bottle arranged around a central “New Product” diamond. Warm yellow, peach, and orange backdrops with crisp white borders and strong side-lit shadows create a minimal, sunlit look.

A minimalist flat lay shows a white pump bottle centered among a black dropper bottle, white jar and ceramics, an espresso cup, and scattered coffee beans on a warm peach background. Sunlit shadows and the contrast of white, black, gold, and deep brown create a clean, modern composition.

A minimalist graphic shows a centered white diamond (a rotated square with slightly rounded corners) on a solid black background. The composition is symmetrical, high-contrast, and dominated by clean lines and negative space.
